content.comment_body: I'm attempting to transfer a program from a PLC to [product_name] software. The process initiates but ultimately fails with the error: "Only diagram above [version_no] can be uploaded." My PLC is [product_name] [version_no]. The software version I used is [product_name] [version_no].

Additional information is needed: You indicated that you have a [product_name] [version_no], not [version_no], meaning there is no Ethernet port. Is this correct? If so, it's not possible to upload the program from the PLC to the PC using network mode. Please provide the exact order number ([article_no]) of your [product_name].
As suggested by our expert, try switching to diagram mode and attempt the upload again.

Yes, my [product_name] [version_no] does not have an Ethernet port. I used a USB cable as the communication interface, and it connected successfully to the PLC. The software prompted me to stop the PLC before uploading. However, the same error appeared after attempting the upload. Would using [product_name] [version_no] work, or is my PLC model incompatible with uploading?
Thanks, I will try this suggestion as well.

Thank you everyone. I was able to successfully upload the logic from the PLC. The issue was caused by a version mismatch—original logic was created with [product_name] [version_no], so I needed to use [version_no] to complete the upload.
That's not accurate. With [product_name] [version_no], you can create, upload, and transfer programs between all supported [product_name] versions and your PC.

However, you cannot create programs for a higher version than your [product_name]. For example, if you develop logic intended for a newer version, it cannot be transferred to an older one. Sometimes, [product_name] can convert the program to a lower version, depending on the blocks used.

[user_name], always ensure you select the correct [product_name] type using the option in the lower right corner of the software. Double-click there, and the software will restrict programming capabilities to what your [product_name] supports.
Can you share the source of that information? I haven't been able to locate it.
Hello [user_name], I previously created some screen recordings. In these videos, the software version displays hardware choices and the uploading process from a [product_name] [version_no] to PC.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced difficulty uploading a program from a PLC to [product_name] [version_no], mainly due to a version mismatch between the logic and the software. The discussion centered around software compatibility requirements and the importance of selecting the correct hardware type, which directly affects usability and user confidence.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to upload programs smoothly from PLC to PC, regardless of the software version, provided their hardware is compatible and properly connected. They desire clear error handling and direct information regarding compatibility between software versions and existing logic.
